items.title: 4 self-hosting failures that return success
items.markdown: Four ways a self-hosted server reports success while being broken: a `200` on a gated WebDAV endpoint, a healthcheck with no `curl` in the image, a backup that exits 0 with an empty archive, and a Wake-on-LAN packet that quietly evaporates. Companion repo: [sober-selfhost](https://github.com/mbaelde/sober-selfhost).
